As a coffee company in Rotterdam, we couldn’t ignore it anymore — matcha had to be added to our assortment. But which one? And what exactly is really good matcha? Through mutual connections, I got in touch with Robbert-Jan from Pure Matcha Partners. We quickly set up an introduction. He came by and fully immersed me in the world of matcha. We tasted several matchas and experienced the different flavor profiles.

One clear winner came out of the tasting:

Premium Matcha South China. What really made the difference for us was the fact that the matcha is traded fairly. They know the farmers and pay a fair price. So… it was a match(a)!After that, everything was arranged quickly. Ordering is easy through the online shop, and within two days it was delivered. They also offer bowls and whisks — super convenient!Thank you for your enthusiasm and all the valuable matcha knowledge.
